intents.name: advisory_services
intents.answer:
📊 *Northwind Capital — Advisory & Compliance Services*

• *Tax Planning & Filing:* Individual income tax (salary, capital gains, F&O) and advance tax computation.
• *Business Compliance:* GST registration & monthly/quarterly returns, TDS returns, and ROC company filings.
• *Investment Advisory:* Goal-based retirement planning, mutual fund portfolio reviews, and risk analysis.

_Note: First consultation (30 minutes) is complimentary!_

intents.name: service_guide
intents.answer:
📑 *Northwind Capital — Engagement Terms*

• *Transparent Pricing:* Fixed-fee engagements for tax filings and monthly retainers for corporate compliance.
• *Dedicated Advisor:* A named financial advisor is assigned to every client.
• *Fiduciary Standard:* Advisory is delivered only after a signed engagement letter and risk profiling.

intents.name: compliance_faqs
intents.answer:
🗓️ *Key Statutory Deadlines (Indicative)*

• *GST:* GSTR-1 by 11th; GSTR-3B by 20th of every month.
• *TDS Payment:* 7th of every month; returns quarterly.
• *Advance Tax:* 15 Jun / 15 Sep / 15 Dec / 15 Mar.
• *ITR:* 31 July for individuals (unless extended by CBDT).

_Facing an audit or tax notice? Select 'Request a Proposal' or 'Book a Callback'._
